title: phaenopyrum parvifolium
intro: Phaenopyrum parvifolium, commonly known as Chinese tree of heaven, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues such as asthma and bronchitis. The health benefits of Phaenopyrum parvifolium are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
